verification_status: Publisher-wide policies verified; journal-specific Guide for Authors and current aims/scope could not be read because the journal pages returned access errors. No access restriction or CAPTCHA was bypassed.

verified_publisher_policies.level: conditional publisher requirement if Highlights are submitted; not verified as mandatory for this journal
facts: Submit a separate editable source file, not PDF, named Highlights.
Include 3 to 5 bullet points.
Each bullet has a maximum of 85 characters including spaces.
Restrict highlights to core results.
Official support explicitly says mandatory for some journals and optional for others.
Include a separate manuscript AI declaration immediately before the references.
Name the tool, describe its purpose, and confirm author review and responsibility.
Substantive changes to sentence structure or content organization require disclosure; basic spelling, punctuation, and grammar checks do not.
Where AI supports research methods, code development, analysis, or data visualization, describe its use reproducibly in Methods.
AI-assisted data visualizations are permitted only when faithfully derived from underlying data through reproducible methods; report tool/model name, version, and developer/manufacturer in Methods.
Primary research images, including HE microscopy and Western blots, must not be fabricated or altered by generative AI.
General-purpose generative AI image tools must not be used for graphical abstracts.

verified_publisher_policies.level: publisher supports statements; journal-specific mandate not verified
facts: A data statement can identify availability and give the reason data cannot be accessed.
Authors may be asked to provide raw data for editorial review.
Do not claim complete raw data availability where only processed lists or archival images are retained.

verified_publisher_policies.level: publisher guidance, journal-specific mandatory status not verified
facts: Corresponding author ensures contribution descriptions are accurate and agreed by all authors.
List roles for all authors using applicable CRediT categories.
An author can have multiple roles.
The CRediT page says statements should be provided during submission; the overarching author-policy page describes contribution transparency as encouraged.

verified_publisher_policies.level: publisher technical baseline, subject to journal-specific rules
facts: EPS/PDF recommended for vector graphics, TIFF for raster art, JPEG accepted for photographs; Microsoft Office files are accepted.
Bitmap halftone photographs: 300 dpi; line/halftone combinations: 500 dpi; bitmap line art: 1000 dpi.
Common sizes: 90 mm single column, 140 mm one-and-a-half columns, 190 mm full width.
Lettering approximately 7 pt at final size, at least 6 pt for subscripts/superscripts, is a rule of thumb rather than a strict rule.
Captions may be uploaded as a Figure Caption text item if provided; otherwise list captions at end of manuscript.
Do not increase bitmap resolution through upsampling to claim better image quality.
Official FAQ recommends figures no larger than 10 MB and, for several figures, no larger than 7 MB each for upload convenience; this is not a verified hard limit for this journal.

verified_publisher_policies.level: publisher general guidance, not a confirmed journal-specific style
facts: The official support page says journal-specific Guide for Authors determines style and whether Your Paper Your Way applies.
A numeric square-bracket style and reference list in order of first citation is one officially documented Elsevier style.
Do not claim the journal currently accepts any consistent format without confirming its Guide for Authors.
Disclose relationships that could present a potential conflict.
Human or animal research requires compliance statements.
A thesis is generally not prior publication under Elsevier policy; journal-specific exceptions may apply.
Shared previously published blood-pressure data must be cited and disclosed rather than presented as a new independent dataset.

not_verified_as_current_journal_rules.status: An unstructured abstract at most 250 words appears in third-party summaries, but was not verified against readable official journal guidance. Using a concise standalone abstract of at most 250 words is a conservative preparation choice, not a confirmed journal limit.
The 1–7 count appears in third-party summaries only. Using six focused keywords is a conservative editorial choice, not a confirmed journal requirement.

not_verified_as_current_journal_rules.topic: Research Article word and display-item limits
not_verified_as_current_journal_rules.status: No official current hard limit verified. Do not claim 4600 words or four figures as Research Article requirements. Do not cut valid results solely to meet those third-party figures.
No current journal mandate verified. Numbered sections and subsections can be used as consistent editorial formatting.
Numeric citations and an Elsevier numeric bibliography can be prepared, but no claim of mandated or format-free initial submission is supported by readable current journal guidance.
Provide separate source figure files as a practical complete submission package. Current BBRep-specific initial-submission rule unverified.
Mandatory/optional status for BBRep unverified. Do not create one merely on an assumed requirement.

not_verified_as_current_journal_rules.topic: CRediT, Highlights, and data statement as required submission items
not_verified_as_current_journal_rules.status: Journal-specific hard requirement unverified. Include these useful items without representing uncertain mandatory status as fact.
Current official scope page inaccessible; do not present cached third-party descriptions as verified current scope.

editorial_choices_supported_without_clai: Prepare as Research Article rather than Short Communication, preserving complete supported results.
Use an unstructured abstract at most 250 words and six focused keywords.
Use numbered Introduction, Materials and methods, Results, Discussion, and Conclusions, with consistent subsections.
Prepare a separate editable Highlights file with three to five bullets each at most 85 characters.
Retain editable tables and native editable equations; supply original-resolution separate figure files and clear legends.
Keep data availability, animal ethics, funding, CRediT, competing-interest, and AI disclosure statements consistent with actual evidence.
Retain archived BP and HE as supplementary descriptive material with limitations; journal retargeting does not resolve missing provenance or biological sample counts.
sources_deliberately_not_used_as_current: Old editor correspondence hosted in institutional repositories.
The official Elsevier Next-journals generic author guide, which is not BBRep guidance.
